scope: Time Patrol Support Pack Puar CC Mascot identity reconciliation
purpose: Establish Puar as an exact CC Mascot identity and determine the correct canonical-domain treatment without misclassifying it as equipment, accessory, skill, or consumable.

evidence.finding: CC Mascots are a distinct Xenoverse 2 lobby-item category. Puar is listed as a CC Mascot, separate from equipment/accessories, with TP Medal Shop and STP Medal Shop routes; a separate Puar duplicate is attributed to the Super Time Patrol Support Pack.
Historical TP Medal Shop schedule independently documents Puar as a CC Mascot shop item.
Official PlayStation storefront lists CC Mascots (Puar) among Time Patrol Support Pack contents.

separation_rules: Do not create an equipment or accessory ID for Puar.
Do not collapse Puar into the Puar color-variant mascot identities.
Do not treat the Support Pack duplicate as proof that the base Puar mascot is DLC-exclusive.
Do not infer mascot behavior, color, price, rotation, or duplicate-slot semantics beyond the cited evidence.

architecture_finding.current_repo_state: No dedicated canonical CC Mascot record layer was found in the live repository search.
architecture_finding.existing_dlc_projection: The DLC content reconciliation already has a cc_mascots count of 1 but no canonical target ID.
architecture_finding.required_next_architecture: Introduce a dedicated CC Mascot identity/catalog layer before assigning a canonical Puar ID, so the domain can support Puar plus its documented color variants and other mascots without forcing them into equipment/accessory schemas.

next_action: Design and add the smallest dedicated CC Mascot canonical/catalog schema that can represent Puar and variants, then promote Puar only after schema/index parity and DLC navigation consumers can be validated.
